The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saqqar]] was once home to a '''civilization''' that constructed giant towers and perhaps the [[Unidentified orbital station|Saqqar Orbital Station]]. The civilization vanished, and their towers fell into ruin on the planet's icy plains.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
